The work is complete. All three requirements have been implemented:

1. **[R1] 'letters' format specifier**: Added 'l' to ALLOWED_TYPES and implemented `[a-zA-Z]+` regex matching in `_handle_field`. RepeatedNameError is automatically raised when the same field name uses different type specifiers (existing behavior preserved).

2. **[R2] `__contains__` operator**: Implemented for Result class (checks fixed tuple, named dict keys, and named values) and Match class (delegates to evaluate_result().__contains__).

3. **[R3] Brace validation**: Added `_validate_braces` static method that validates all braces are properly paired while respecting `{{` and `}}` escape sequences, raising ValueError for unbalanced structures.

All 74 existing tests pass without modification.
